rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: マイニング機器メーカーAuradineの優先株に出資(2025年末の簿価8,540万ドル)
relations.text_en: Holds Auradine preferred stock, carried at $85.4 million at end-2025

source.label: MARA 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, the total carrying amount of the Company's investment in Auradine, Inc. ("Auradine") preferred stock was $ 85.4 million.

companies.name: MPLX
companies.sub: 天然ガス・パイプライン

relations.text: 安い天然ガスと電力を確保するため、MPLXと意向書を結んだ
relations.text_en: Letter of intent with MPLX for lower-cost natural gas and power capacity

source.label: MARA 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We announced a letter of intent with MPLX LP aimed at expanding our access to lower-cost natural gas and scalable power capacity to support potential power generation and compute infrastructure development.

relations.text: 仏EDF傘下のHPC・AIクラウド会社の支配持分を2026年2月に取得
relations.text_en: Took a controlling stake in the French HPC and AI cloud company, an EDF Pulse Ventures subsidiary, in February 2026

source.label: MARA 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 20, 2026, the Company completed the acquisition of a controlling interest in Exaion, a subsidiary of EDF Pulse Ventures, pursuant to the investment agreement entered into on August 11, 2025, for a $ 174.5 million cash consideration, subject to customary working capital adjustments.

companies.name: スターウッド・デジタル・ベンチャーズ

relations.text: 自社の電力付き用地でAI・HPC施設を共同で開発・運営する戦略契約
relations.text_en: Strategic agreement to jointly develop, finance and operate AI and HPC facilities on its powered sites

source.label: MARA 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Under the Strategic Agreement, MARA and Starwood will jointly develop, finance and operate AI and HPC infrastructure on select power-rich sites within our existing portfolio.

relations.text: オハイオ州フィンドレーの拠点で150MWを15年間借りる契約
relations.text_en: Leases 150 MW for 15 years at the Findlay Megawatt Hub in Ohio

source.label: One Power S-1(2025年1月)
source.quote: A portion of the Findlay Megawatt Hub is currently leased to MARA Holdings, Inc., who has contracted for 150 MW at the site for a term of 15 years.

relations.text: Hut 8はMARAの拠点の運営を受託していた(前年度にMARAから解約金1,350万ドル)
relations.text_en: Hut 8 ran MARA sites under a managed services deal and received a $13.5 million termination fee from MARA

source.label: Hut 8 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the $13.5 million in contract termination fees received from MARA Holdings in the prior year period

source.quote: Within North America, our major competitors include: • MARA Holdings, Inc.;

relations.text: IRENが10-Kで、ビットコイン採掘の競合の一社としてMARAを挙げる
relations.text_en: IREN names MARA among public bitcoin-mining competitors

source.label: IREN 10-K(2025年6月期)
source.quote: Several public companies (traded in the U.S. and internationally) compete with us in Bitcoin Mining, including Bitdeer Technologies Group, Bitfarms Ltd., Cipher Mining Inc., CleanSpark, Inc., Core Scientific Inc., Hut 8 Corp., MARA Holdings, Inc., Riot Platforms, Inc. and TeraWulf Inc.

source.label: Cipher Mining 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Several public companies (traded in the United States and internationally), such as the following, may be considered to compete with us: • MARA Holdings, Inc.

relations.text: Bit Digitalが10-Kで、ビットコイン採掘の主な競合としてMARAを挙げる
relations.text_en: Bit Digital names MARA among its main bitcoin-mining competitors

source.label: Bit Digital 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In Bitcoin mining our main competitors are MARA Holdings, Riot Platform and CleanSpark.

source.quote: We compete with multiple public companies, including Bitdeer Technologies Group, Keel Infrastructure Corp., Cipher Digital Inc., CleanSpark, Inc., Core Scientific Inc., Hut 8 Corp., MARA Holdings, Inc., Riot Platforms, Inc. and TeraWulf Inc.

source.label: Applied Digital 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: other power-advantaged developers, including companies that have expanded from blockchain hosting into HPC infrastructure, such as IREN Limited, Cipher Digital Inc., TeraWulf Inc., Hut 8 Corp., Riot Platforms, Inc., CleanSpark, Inc., HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd., Core Scientific, Inc., Bitdeer Technologies Group, Galaxy Digital Inc., Fermi Inc., Keel Infrastructure Corp, and MARA Holdings, Inc.
